snapshot.description: A point in the operational time series.

timestep.description: A timestep of a multi-period network, within a period.

period.description: An investment period, labelled by its year.

scenario.description: One realisation of a stochastic problem.

sub_network.description: A connected part of the network, as PyPSA numbers them.

role.description: An end of a component an attachment can be.

connection.description: An entity's attachment to one bus.

scenario_weight.description: How much this scenario counts in the expectation.

snapshot_weighting_objective.description: How much this snapshot counts in the objective.

snapshot_weighting_stores.description: How long this snapshot lasts for a store's energy.

snapshot_weighting_generators.description: How much this snapshot counts towards a generator's energy limits.

period_weighting_objective.description: How much this period counts in the objective.

period_weighting_years.description: How many years this period lasts.

control.description: P,Q,V control strategy for power flow, must be "PQ", "PV" or "Slack". Only relevant for "AC" and "DC" buses.

p_nom.description: Nominal power for limits  on `p` in optimization. Ignored if `p_nom_extendable=True`.

p_nom_mod.description: Nominal power of the generator module (e.g. fixed unit size of a nuclear power plant). Introduces integer variables if set.

p_nom_extendable.description: Switch to allow capacity `p_nom` to be extended in optimization.

p_nom_min.description: If `p_nom` is extendable in optimization, set its minimum value.

p_nom_max.description: If `p_nom` is extendable in optimization, set its maximum value (e.g. limited by technical potential).

p_nom_set.description: If `p_nom` is extendable in optimization, set its value.

p_min_pu.description: The minimum output for each snapshot per unit of `p_nom` for the optimization (e.g. a minimal dispatch level for conventional power plants). Note that if `committable=False` and `p_min_pu>0`, this represents a must-run condition.

p_max_pu.description: The maximum output for each snapshot per unit of `p_nom` for the optimization (e.g. changing availability of renewable generators due to weather conditions or a de-rating of conventional power plants).

p_set.description: Active power set point (for optimisation and power flow)

p_init.description: Active power used as a starting point for limiting the ramp in the very first snapshot (for optimisation)

e_sum_min.description: The minimum total energy produced during a single optimization horizon.

e_sum_max.description: The maximum total energy produced during a single optimization horizon.

q_set.description: Reactive power set point (for power flow)

marginal_cost.description: Marginal cost of production of 1 MWh.

marginal_cost_quadratic.description: Quadratic marginal cost of production of 1 MWh.

active.description: Whether to consider the component in optimization or not

capital_cost.description: Fixed period costs of extending `p_nom` by 1 MW (e.g. annuitized investment costs). Used directly in optimization unless `overnight_cost` is specified.

overnight_cost.description: Overnight (upfront) investment cost per MW. If specified, PyPSA calculates annuity using `discount_rate` and `lifetime`. Takes precedence over `capital_cost`.

discount_rate.description: Discount rate for annuity calculation when using `overnight_cost`. Supports 0% rate (simple depreciation).

fom_cost.description: Fixed period operation and maintenance costs per MW, added to annuitized investment cost.

efficiency.description: Ratio output and primary energy carrier input (e.g. 0.4 MWh~elec~/MWh~fuel~). This is required for global constraints on primary energy in optimization.

maintenance_duration.description: Elapsed time per maintenance event. Each event covers consecutive snapshots whose weightings sum to at least this value. Only if `maintainable=True`.

maintenance_pu.description: Fraction of capacity unavailable during maintenance (0-1). Only if `maintainable=True`.

maintenance_events.description: Number of required maintenance events per optimization horizon. Only if `maintainable=True`.

start_up_cost.description: Cost to start up the generator. Only used if `committable=True`.

shut_down_cost.description: Cost to shut down the generator. Only used if `committable=True`.

stand_by_cost.description: Stand-by cost for running the generator. This cost is incurred whenever the status is 1 (including when the dispatch decision is zero).

min_up_time.description: Minimum number of snapshots for status to be 1. Only used if `committable=True`. Does not consider snapshot weightings.

min_down_time.description: Minimum number of snapshots for status to be 0. Only used if `committable=True`. Does not consider snapshot weightings.

up_time_before.description: Number of snapshots that the generator was online before the first optimized snapshot. Replaced by the solved status if earlier snapshots were already optimized. Only used if `committable=True`. Does not consider snapshot weightings.

down_time_before.description: Number of snapshots that the generator was offline before the first optimized snapshot. Replaced by the solved status if earlier snapshots were already optimized. Takes precedence over `up_time_before` if positive. Only used if `committable=True`. Does not consider snapshot weightings.

ramp_limit_up.description: Maximum active power increase from one snapshot to the next, per unit of the nominal power. Ignored if NaN. Does not consider snapshot weightings.

ramp_limit_down.description: Maximum active power decrease from one snapshot to the next, per unit of the nominal power. Ignored if NaN. Does not consider snapshot weightings.

ramp_limit_start_up.description: Maximum active power increase at start up, per unit of the nominal power. Only used if `committable=True`. Ignored if NaN.

ramp_limit_shut_down.description: Maximum active power decrease at shut down, per unit of the nominal power. Only used if `committable=True`. Ignored if NaN.

weight.description: Weighting of a generator. Only used for network clustering.

investment_period.description: Investment period for which the constraint is applied. If not specified, the constraint is applied to all investment periods together.

carrier_attribute.description: If the global constraint is connected with a carrier, name the associated carrier attribute. This must appear as a column in `n.carriers`.

sense.description: Constraint sense; must be one of <=, == or >=

constant.description: Constant for right-hand-side of constraint for optimisation period. For a CO~2~ constraint, this would be tonnes of CO~2~.

x.description: Series reactance, must be non-zero for AC branch for linearised power flow equations. If the line has series inductance $L$ in Henries then $x = 2\\pi f L$ where $f$ is the frequency in Hertz. Series impedance $z = r + jx$ must be non-zero for non-linear power flow calculations. Ignored if `type` defined.

r.description: Series resistance, must be non-zero for DC branch for linearised power flow equations. Series impedance $z = r + jx$ must be non-zero for the non-linear power flow. Ignored if `type` defined.

g.description: Shunt conductivity. Shunt admittance is $y = g + jb$.

b.description: Shunt susceptance. If the line has shunt capacitance $C$ in Farads then $b = 2\\pi f C$ where $f$ is the frequency in Hertz. Shunt admittance is $y = g + jb$. Ignored if `type` defined.

s_nom.description: Limit of apparent power which can pass through branch in either direction. Ignored if `s_nom_extendable=True`.

s_nom_mod.description: Modular unit size of line expansion of `s_nom` (e.g. fixed rating of added circuit). Introduces integer variables.

s_nom_extendable.description: Switch to allow capacity `s_nom` to be extended in optimisation.

s_nom_min.description: If `s_nom_extendable=True`, set the minimum value of `s_nom_opt`.

s_nom_max.description: If `s_nom_extendable=True`, set the maximum value of `s_nom_opt`.

s_nom_set.description: If `s_nom` is extendable in optimization, set the value of `s_nom_opt`.

s_max_pu.description: The maximum allowed absolute apparent power flow per unit of `s_nom` for the optimisation (e.g. can set `s_max_pu<1` to approximate $N-1$ contingency factor, or can be time-varying to represent weather-dependent dynamic line rating for overhead lines).

length.description: Length of line used when `type` is set. Also useful for calculating `capital_cost`.

terrain_factor.description: Terrain factor for increasing `length` for `capital_cost` calculation.

num_parallel.description: When `type` is set, this is the number of parallel circuits. Can also be fractional. If `type` is empty "" this value is ignored.

v_ang_min.description: Deprecated and ignored. `v_ang_max` applies symmetrically as an absolute voltage angle difference limit.

v_ang_max.description: Maximum magnitude of the voltage angle difference across the line in degrees. Enforced in the optimisation as a symmetric cap on the line's angle difference. Ignored when inf.

delay.description: Delay of energy delivery to `bus1` in units of `n.snapshot_weightings.generators`. Energy withdrawn from `bus0` at snapshot `t` arrives at the first snapshot whose cumulative generator weighting start is at least `delay` units later. Auto-expanded as `delay2`, `delay3`, etc. for additional ports.

cyclic_delay.description: Whether delayed energy wraps cyclically from end to start of the optimization period. If False, energy is lost at the tail and first snapshots receive nothing from delayed links. Auto-expanded as `cyclic_delay2`, `cyclic_delay3`, etc. for additional ports.

rate.description: Rate of energy transfer at `bus0` relative to internal power `p`. Can be time-dependent (e.g. to represent temperature-dependent heat pump COP).  `Rate`s for further buses (e.g. `bus2`, `bus3`, etc.) are automatically expanded as needed (e.g. `rate2`, `rate3`, etc.).

p_dispatch_set.description: Active power dispatch set point (for optimisation only)

p_store_set.description: Active power charging set point (for optimisation only)

marginal_cost_storage.description: Marginal cost of energy storage of 1 MWh for one hour.

state_of_charge_initial.description: State of charge before the snapshots in the optimisation.

state_of_charge_initial_per_period.description: Switch: if True, the state of charge at the beginning of an investment period is set to `state_of_charge_initial`.

state_of_charge_set.description: State of charge set points for snapshots in the optimisation.

cyclic_state_of_charge.description: Switch: if True, then `state_of_charge_initial` is ignored and the initial state of charge is set to the final state of charge for the group of snapshots in the optimisation (`soc[-1] = soc[len(snapshots)-1]`).

cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period.description: Switch: if True, the cyclic constraints are applied to each investment period separately.

max_hours.description: Maximum state of charge capacity in terms of hours at full output power capacity `p_nom`

efficiency_store.description: Efficiency of storage on the way into the storage.

efficiency_dispatch.description: Efficiency of storage on the way out of the storage.

standing_loss.description: Losses per hour to state of charge.

inflow.description: Inflow to the state of charge (e.g. due to river inflow in hydro reservoir).

e_nom.description: Nominal energy capacity (i.e. limit on `e`). Ignored if `e_nom_extendable=True`.

e_nom_mod.description: Nominal energy capacity of the store module. Introduces integer variables if set.

e_nom_extendable.description: Switch to allow capacity `e_nom` to be extended in optimisation.

e_nom_min.description: If `e_nom_extendable=True`, set the minimum value of `e_nom_opt`.

e_nom_max.description: If `e_nom_extendable=True`, set the maximum value of `e_nom_opt`.

e_min_pu.description: Minimal value of `e` relative to `e_nom` for the optimisation.

e_max_pu.description: Maximal value of `e` relative to `e_nom` for the optimisation.

e_initial.description: Energy before the snapshots in the optimisation.

e_initial_per_period.description: Switch: if True, then at the beginning of each investment period `e` is set to `e_initial`.

e_cyclic.description: Switch: if True, then `e_initial` is ignored and the initial energy is set to the final energy for the group of snapshots in the optimisation.

e_cyclic_per_period.description: Switch: if True, then the cyclic constraints are applied to each investment period separately.

e_set.description: Fixed energy filling level set point (for optimisation only)

model.description: Model used for admittance matrix; can be "t" or "pi"; defaults to "t" following physics and DIgSILENT PowerFactory

tap_ratio.description: Ratio of per unit voltages at each bus for tap changed. Ignored if type defined.

tap_side.description: Defines if tap changer is modelled at the primary 0 side (usually high-voltage) or the secondary 1 side (usually low voltage) (must be 0 or 1, defaults to 0). Ignored if type defined.

tap_position.description: If the transformer has a `type`, the absolute tap position on the same scale as `tap_min`/`tap_neutral`/`tap_max`. The off-nominal voltage ratio is computed from the offset to `tap_neutral`, so the nominal ratio (`tap_ratio` = 1) is obtained when `tap_position == tap_neutral`.

phase_shift.description: Voltage phase angle shift setpoint. Ignored if type defined. Sign convention follows `pf`/`lpf`: the realised flow is P = (theta0 - theta1 - phase_shift) / x, so the KVL cycle constraint reads sum_l C_lk * (x_l * P_l + phase_shift_l) = 0 (in rad). This is the negative of the angle convention in Verboomen 2008 (= -alpha_Verboomen); do not flip the sign towards the paper or LOPF will diverge from `pf`/`lpf` (issue #1220). When `phase_shift_min < phase_shift_max` the shift becomes a per-snapshot decision variable instead and `phase_shift` is ignored.

phase_shift_min.description: Lower bound (degrees) for the per-snapshot phase shift. When `phase_shift_min < phase_shift_max` the shift is optimised as a decision variable bounded by `phase_shift_min`/`phase_shift_max` (e.g. a phase-shifting transformer whose tap the TSO optimises); otherwise the shift is fixed to `phase_shift`.

phase_shift_max.description: Upper bound (degrees) for the per-snapshot phase shift. See `phase_shift_min`.

v_mag_pu_set.description: Voltage magnitude set point, per unit of `v_nom`.

v_mag_pu_min.description: Minimum desired voltage, per unit of `v_nom`. Placeholder attribute not currently used by any functions.

v_mag_pu_max.description: Maximum desired voltage, per unit of `v_nom`.  Placeholder attribute not currently used by any functions.

co2_emissions.description: Emissions in tCO~2~ per MWh of primary energy (e.g. methane has 0.2 tCO~2~/MWh~thermal~).

max_growth.description: Maximum new installed capacity per investment period

max_relative_growth.description: Maximum capacity ratio for new installed capacity per investment period

marginal_price.description: Shadow price from energy balance constraint

capital_cost_piecewise_opt.description: Optimised capital cost when using piecewise linearisation.

maintenance.description: Maintenance status (1=in maintenance). Only returned if `maintainable=True`.

maintenance_start.description: Whether a maintenance event begins in the snapshot (1 is yes, 0 is no). Only returned if `maintainable=True`.

marginal_cost_piecewise_opt.description: Optimised marginal cost when using piecewise linearisation.

mu_p_set.description: Shadow price of fixed power generation `p_set`

mu_ramp_limit_down.description: Shadow price of lower ramp down limit

mu_ramp_limit_up.description: Shadow price of upper ramp up limit

p.description: Active power at bus (positive if net generation)

shut_down.description: Whether the unit was shut down in the snapshot (1 is yes, 0 is no).  Only returned if `committable=True`.

start_up.description: Whether the unit was started in the snapshot (1 is yes, 0 is no). Only returned if `committable=True`.

status.description: Status in the snapshot (1 is on, 0 is off). Only returned if `committable=True`.

b_pu.description: Per unit shunt susceptance calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `b` and `n.buses.v_nom`.

g_pu.description: Per unit shunt conductivity calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `g` and `n.buses.v_nom`.

r_pu.description: Per unit series resistance calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `r` and `n.buses.v_nom`.

r_pu_eff.description: Effective per unit series resistance for linear power flow, calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `r` and `n.buses.v_nom`

s_nom_opt.description: Optimised nominal capacity for apparent power.

sub_network.description: Name of sub-network to which lines belongs, as calculated by `n.determine_network_topology()`. Do not set by hand.

x_pu.description: Per unit series reactance calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `x` and `n.buses.v_nom`.

x_pu_eff.description: Effective per unit series reactance for linear power flow, calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `x` and `n.buses.v_nom`

p_internal.description: Internal power (positive if link is withdrawing from `bus0`).

mu_energy_balance.description: Shadow price of storage consistency equations

mu_state_of_charge_set.description: Shadow price of fixed state of charge state_of_charge_set

spill.description: Spillage for each snapshot (e.g. hydro-dam letting water flow over the spillway without generating electricity).

state_of_charge.description: State of charge as calculated by the optimisation.

e.description: Energy level of store as calculated by the optimisation.

e_nom_opt.description: Optimised nominal energy capacity outputed by optimisation.

phase_shift_opt.description: Realised per-snapshot voltage phase angle shift. Equals `phase_shift` for fixed transformers; for optimised transformers (`phase_shift_min < phase_shift_max`) it holds the value chosen by `n.optimize()`.

ctype.description: What kind of entity an entity is.

carrier.description: Prime mover energy carrier (e.g. coal, gas, wind, solar); required for global constraints on primary energy in optimisation

sign.description: Sign denoting the orientation of the dispatch variable (e.g. positive for generation, negative for consumption).

type.description: Placeholder for generator type. Not implemented.
Placeholder for bus type. Not implemented.

x.description: Longitude; the Spatial Reference System Identifier (SRID) is set in `n.srid`.

y.description: Latitude; the Spatial Reference System Identifier (SRID) is set in `n.srid`.

unit.description: Unit of the bus' carrier if the implicitly assumed unit ("MW") is inappropriate (e.g. "t/h"). Only descriptive. Does not influence any PyPSA functions.

location.description: Location of the bus. Does not influence the optimisation model but can be used for aggregation with `n.statistics`.

shape_onshore.description: A shape outlining the label, as WKT in the CRS `meta` names.

shape_offshore.description: A shape outlining the label, as WKT in the CRS `meta` names.

color.description: Color for plotting (e.g. `matplotlib` [named colors](https://matplotlib.org/stable/gallery/color/named_colors.html) or hexadecimal color codes like "#AB9812")

nice_name.description: Descriptive name for statistics and visualisations (e.g. "Natural Gas" for carrier `gas`)

carrier.description: The carrier of a sub-network's buses.

mounting.description: Can be "ol" for overhead line or "cs" for cable

v_nom_0.description: Nominal voltage on high voltage side

v_nom_1.description: Nominal voltage on low voltage side

vscr.description: Real part of short circuit voltage

tap_side.description: Defines if tap changer is modelled at the primary 0 side (usually high-voltage) or the secondary 1 side (usually low voltage) (must be 0 or 1, defaults to 0)

tap_neutral.description: Rated tap position, i.e. position at which the winding ratio corresponds to the ratio of the rated voltages

tap_step.description: Tap step size in percentage of voltage change

role.description: Which end of the component this attachment is.

period.description: The investment period a snapshot falls in.

timestep.description: PyPSA's timestep of a snapshot labelled by its position.

shape_onshore.description: A shape outlining the label, as WKT in the CRS `meta` names.

shape_offshore.description: A shape outlining the label, as WKT in the CRS `meta` names.

electricity.powerplants_filter: (DateOut > 2025 or DateOut != DateOut) and (DateIn < 2026 or DateIn != DateIn)

not included: Bioethanol barley, wheat, grain maize, oats, other cereals and rye

utilisation_rate: urban central solid biomass CHP CC
